# Generated by uniffi-bindgen-react-native (Nitro backend)
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.9.0)
{%- let name = self.config.project.module_cpp() %}
project({{ name }})

{%- let root = self.project_root() %}
{%- let dir = self.config.project.bindings.cpp_path(root) %}
{%- let bindings_dir = self.relative_to(root, dir) %}
{%- let is_so_lib = self.config.project.android.use_shared_library %}
{%- let is_static_lib = !is_so_lib %}

set (CMAKE_VERBOSE_MAKEFILE ON)
# Nitro requires C++20.
set (CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)

# Resolve the path to the uniffi-bindgen-react-native package (for cpp/includes).
execute_process(
    COMMAND node -p "require.resolve('uniffi-bindgen-react-native/package.json')"
    OUTPUT_VARIABLE UNIFFI_BINDGEN_PATH
    OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE
)
get_filename_component(UNIFFI_BINDGEN_PATH "${UNIFFI_BINDGEN_PATH}" DIRECTORY)

include_directories(
    {{ bindings_dir }}
    ${UNIFFI_BINDGEN_PATH}/cpp/includes
)

# The single shared library `{{ name }}` compiles our self-emitted C++
# sources directly: every HybridObject impl, `register_natives.cpp` (which
# registers them with `HybridObjectRegistry` at library-load time via a
# static initializer), and `cpp-adapter.cpp` (whose `JNI_OnLoad` just returns
# `JNI_VERSION_1_6` so `System.loadLibrary("{{ name }}")` succeeds). We do NOT
# include any nitrogen autolinking output — registration is self-contained.
#
# Sources are an explicit, lexically-sorted enumeration of every
# HybridObject impl emitted by `ubrn_bindgen`'s `gen_nitro`; we avoid
# `file(GLOB)` because globbing defers source discovery to configure
# time and silently misses files added between configure and build.
add_library({{ name }} SHARED
    {%- for func in self.config.nitro_hybrid_objects %}
    {{ bindings_dir }}/{{ func.cxx_class }}.cpp
    {%- endfor %}
    {{ bindings_dir }}/register_natives.cpp
    cpp-adapter.cpp
)

set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -fexceptions")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -frtti")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -fstack-protector-all")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -Wall")
# 16KB page alignment for Android 15+.
set(CMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS} -Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384")

{%- let dir = self.config.project.android.jni_libs(root) %}
{%- let jni_libs_dir = self.relative_to(root, dir) %}

cmake_path(
  SET MY_RUST_LIB
  ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/{{ jni_libs_dir }}/${ANDROID_ABI}/{{ self.config.rust_crate.library_file(Some("android"), Some(*self.config.project.android.use_shared_library)) }}
  NORMALIZE
)

{%- if is_static_lib %}
add_library(my_rust_lib STATIC IMPORTED)
set_target_properties(my_rust_lib PROPERTIES IMPORTED_LOCATION ${MY_RUST_LIB})
{%- endif %}
{%- if is_so_lib %}
add_library(my_rust_lib SHARED IMPORTED)
set_target_properties(my_rust_lib PROPERTIES IMPORTED_LOCATION ${MY_RUST_LIB} IMPORTED_NO_SONAME ON)
{%- endif %}

find_library(LOGCAT log)

# Link against the runtime packages directly (this replaces the nitrogen-
# generated autolinking cmake): fbjni for the JNI bridge, ReactAndroid::jsi
# for the JSI runtime, and react-native-nitro-modules for the HybridObject +
# Dispatcher + HybridObjectRegistry. The react-native-nitro-modules npm
# package ships the prefab CMake config the React Native gradle plugin
# imports.
find_package(fbjni REQUIRED CONFIG)
find_package(ReactAndroid REQUIRED CONFIG)
find_package(react-native-nitro-modules REQUIRED CONFIG)

target_link_libraries(
  {{ name }}
  ${LOGCAT}
  my_rust_lib
  fbjni::fbjni
  ReactAndroid::jsi
  react-native-nitro-modules::NitroModules
)

# Link react-native itself (the prefab target name changed between RN 0.75
# and 0.76).
if(ReactAndroid_VERSION_MINOR GREATER_EQUAL 76)
  target_link_libraries({{ name }} ReactAndroid::reactnative)
else()
  target_link_libraries({{ name }} ReactAndroid::react_nativemodule_core)
endif()
